objective: One inspectable public path from charter source to a revision-bound working-group review, with reproducible exports and a separately governed human decision boundary.
public_forum_choice: Use the existing GitHub Discussions forum and email alternative first. Discourse remains an optional future service, not a launch dependency.

steps.work: Combine the charter register, committed working-group infrastructure and current master without replacing other lanes' source.
steps.acceptance: Clean isolated checkout; preserved charter/frozen root; current input hashes; related PRs and source revisions recorded.

steps.work: Connect every reference source to its forming groups and pinned review documents.
steps.acceptance: Draft retains register, charter and tracker hashes, document IDs/versions and validated public participation routes. No submission or approval is inferred.

steps.work: Render the site, HF static files, offline Kaggle notebook and local MCP configuration from the canonical sources.
steps.acceptance: Website/HF payload parity; offline notebook executes; changed source or generated output fails the exporter; source licences retained.

steps.work: Run the integrity, MCP, native working-group and browser journeys on the combined source.
steps.acceptance: Failure controls, stale revision refusal, mobile/keyboard/no-JavaScript reading, safe draft export and real stdio round trip pass. Representative-user and screen-reader acceptance remain separate.

steps.work: Land the reviewed candidate through protected master and the existing GitHub Actions deployment.
steps.acceptance: Required checks on the current combined tree; no admin bypass or direct Pages write; deployed source and public artifact hashes read back, including delayed anti-clobber checks.

steps.work: Publish only approved public projections to verified existing publisher accounts and qualify each receiving surface.
steps.acceptance: Record exact destination, source revision, returned publication ID and readback. No GPU, model-spend, private-case or licence changes. Unavailable destinations remain explicitly unverified.

steps.work: Appoint genuine chairs, reviewers and moderators and exercise one bounded human review with independent appeal.
steps.acceptance: Actual acceptance, competence/conflict record, named identity, privacy/retention and publication consent. No fabricated member or model-signed human decision.

steps.work: Recover exact historical normalized legal texts or introduce explicitly distinct replacement source versions.
steps.acceptance: Exact normalization and source-byte match before a record stops being unresolved; scoped applicability reviewed by an accountable person. Never rewrite historical hashes.

related_work.purpose: Working-group directory, tracker, forum/intake routes, SDK preview, static exports and SQLite feasibility lab.
Charter source federation and this integration/completion work.
Existing four-critical-dependency remediation with behavioural regression checks; preserve its separate ownership and release evidence.
Merged HF/Kaggle catalogue and benchmark integrity work; do not overwrite its publication changes.
Agent SDK authority/effect integration and recipient evidence verification; qualified host/human admission remains separate.

human_roles_required: reviewer with competence and conflicts recorded
evidence_rules: Reference is not adoption or endorsement.
A browser link is not submission or consent.
A generated projection is not a hosted readback.
An authenticated transport is not by itself a named human identity.
Historical and overlapping test counts are never summed.
